steps.what: Enter the fields for network support activities
Document network support activities from those fields
Review the network support activity record
File the accepted network support record

tasks.design: The specialist documents network support activities. {HELPDESK} copies only fields the specialist entered. It does not write the activity. A blank action stays blank and stops the record. Only the accepted record is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist wrote each activity as free text and filed it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored activity fields can be copied into a record. The specialist still enters them and reviews the record.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what the activity was stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a record that fills a blank action.
tasks.altitude: The record is filed only after the specialist accepts that version. The text is not generated.

reach.learn: Which activities had a blank action.

evidence.claim: Stored activity fields can be copied into a support record. The specialist enters and reviews them.

assumptions: The work starts with a support activity and ends when the accepted record is filed, or the specialist stops.
An activity field set has activity identifier, network name, action, and time, entered by the specialist. A blank action is left blank and is not invented.
Filing uses the record accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which actions every activity record must include.
research_questions: How often did a blank action stop the record?

already_counted.description: Entering the activity fields is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct an action before the record is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: actions are often blank, so the specialist still writes the record. High: fields are complete, the specialist reviews, and only the accepted record is filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Configure wide area network routers or related equipment
Configure local area network routers or related equipment
Review the router configuration before it is applied

tasks.design: The specialist configures wide area network or local area network routers or related equipment. {OPS_SYSTEM} does not choose the configuration. It applies only the version the specialist has accepted. A blank parameter stays blank and stops the apply.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist configured the router and typed the same values again to apply them.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted configuration can be applied. Choosing the values stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing router parameters stays with the specialist, on the equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a configuration the requirement does not support.
tasks.altitude: The configuration is applied only after the specialist accepts that version.

reach.task: Hear which router was left unchanged

evidence.claim: An accepted router configuration can be applied later. Choosing the configuration stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a router and a requirement and ends when the accepted configuration is applied, or the specialist stops.
A router proposal has router identifier and parameter name with value, entered by the specialist. A blank value is left blank and is not invented.
The apply uses the configuration accepted in the review. It does not choose parameters.
unknowns: Which parameters a specialist may apply without a second person.
research_questions: How often did a blank parameter stop the apply?

already_counted.description: Configuring the routers is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a parameter before the configuration is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: parameters are often blank, so the specialist still configures the router. High: values are complete, the specialist reviews them, and only the accepted configuration is applied. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare the install of network software including security
Prepare the firewall software configuration to install
Review the firewall software install before it is applied
Apply the accepted firewall software install

tasks.design: The specialist installs network software, including security or firewall software. {OPS_SYSTEM} does not choose what to install. It applies only the firewall install the specialist has accepted. A blank setting stays blank and stops the apply. This apply is not a fault close.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist prepared the firewall install and applied it by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted install can be applied. Choosing the software and the settings stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what to install, including the firewall, stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses an install the package does not support.
tasks.altitude: The firewall install is applied only after the specialist accepts that version.

reach.task: Hear which firewall install was refused

evidence.claim: An accepted firewall install can be applied later. Choosing what to install stays manual.
The specialist who accepts a firewall install remains responsible for it. The applicable rules are those in force for this organisation.

assumptions: The work starts with a software package and ends when the accepted install is applied, or the specialist stops.
An install proposal has package identifier and setting name with value, entered by the specialist. A blank setting is left blank and is not invented.
The apply uses the install accepted in the review. It does not choose the software.
unknowns: Which firewall settings require a second person before they are applied.
research_questions: How often did a blank setting stop the install?

already_counted.description: Preparing the network software install is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a setting before the install is accepted.

approvals.approved_version: firewall software install the specialist accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: settings are often blank, so the specialist still prepares the install. High: settings are complete, the specialist reviews them, and only the accepted install is applied. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored symptom for these users
Troubleshoot network or connectivity problems for users
Troubleshoot the same problems for user groups

tasks.design: The specialist troubleshoots network or connectivity problems for users or user groups. {HELPDESK} only shows a stored symptom. A blank symptom stays blank. Showing it does not shorten the troubleshooting, which stays at full effort. Nothing closes the fault.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist read the symptom and troubleshot the problem with the user.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored symptom can be shown. The troubleshooting stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Finding the fault, for a user or a group, stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not close a fault the symptom does not support.
tasks.altitude: Troubleshooting stays at full effort. The screen only shows the stored symptom. The fault is not closed by a rule.

reach.task: Stay with the user during the call

evidence.claim: A stored symptom can be shown. Troubleshooting network or connectivity problems stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a user problem and ends when the specialist has a finding or stopped. The fault is not closed here.
A symptom row has request identifier, user identifier, and symptom text, entered by the specialist from the user. A blank symptom is left blank.
Showing the symptom does not shorten the troubleshooting. Nobody is scored.
unknowns: Which problems must be escalated before the specialist leaves the user.
research_questions: How often was the symptom blank, so the specialist asked the user again?

already_counted.description: Troubleshooting for users is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a user identifier on a symptom the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: symptoms are often blank, so the troubleshooting is unchanged. High: the symptom opens, and the specialist still troubleshoots the problem. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
